title: Bump pulldown-cmark to 0.13.5 in the osf crate
summary: A dependency-only change: the `osf` crate pins `pulldown-cmark` from 0.13.4 to 0.13.5, and Cargo.lock records the new version and checksum. No source code changes; the Markdown parsing path inside `osf` keeps the same API surface, only the patch release of the parser moves.
